# Kevin Eaton

> Kevin Eaton, PhD is a technology leader, US Army Reserve Chaplain, professor, and martial arts instructor. This is the hub page linking to his professional sites, each covering one area of his work.

## Sites

- [Technology](https://tech.kevineaton.net): Software architecture, engineering leadership, and entrepreneurship - experience, skills, and projects.
- [Military](https://military.kevineaton.net): US Army Reserve service as a Chaplain (Lieutenant Colonel) - highlights, awards, assignments, and promotions.
- [Academia](https://academia.kevineaton.net): Education history, university teaching experience, and academic publications.
- [Martial Arts](https://martialarts.kevineaton.net): Taekwondo, Tangsoodo, Shotokan Karate, and weapons training - focus areas, training/certifications, competitions, and rank promotions.
